Promotional offers not available in Mississippi, New York, Ontario, or Puerto Rico.The Clemson Tigers (23-9) and the No. 19 North Carolina Tar Heels (24-7) meet Thursday in an ACC Tournament quarterfinal game. Tip-off from Spectrum Center in Charlotte, North Carolina, is scheduled for 9:30 p.m. ET (ESPN). Let's analyze BetMGM Sportsbook's NCAA basketball odds around the Clemson vs. North Carolina odds and make our expert college basketball picks and predictions for the best bets.These teams met once during the regular season, with the Tar Heels winning 67-63 as a 2.5-point favorite as the Under (141.5) cashed on March 3 in Chapel Hill. That win was the difference between UNC getting the No. 4 seed in this tournament, and Clemson getting the No. 5 seed. Clemson F RJ Godfrey had 22 points and 9 rebounds, while UNC G Luka Bogavac went for 20 points.Clemson opened the ACC Tournament with a 71-62 win over the Wake Forest Demon Deacons as a 5.5-point favorite Wednesday as the Under (141.5) cashed. This is UNC's first game in the conference tourney this season.Clemson is 3-5 straight up (SU) in the past 8 games, while going 3-5 against the spread (ATS) in the span. The Under and Over have alternated in each of the past 9 games since Feb. 7. The Under is 8-4 in the past 12 games.North Carolina lost 76-61 at the No. 1 Duke Blue Devils in the regular-season finale, but it covered as an 18.5-point underdog. UNC is 4-1 ATS in the past 5 games, and 9-4 ATS in the previous 13 contests, while the Under is 5-1 in the past 6 games, and 7-2 across the previous 9 outings.– Rankings: USA TODAY Sports Coaches PollTHE BRACKETS ARE BACK! $1 MILLION grand prize for a perfect bracket, $20,000 prize for top bracket. While the Tar Heels barely beat the Tigers in Chapel Hill, and this game is likely to be very close, Clemson has really struggled down the stretch, particularly against the number, and a win over a mediocre Wake Forest team in the opening game of its tournament doesn't change the perception of the Tigers.Against the spreadThere's nothing wrong with NORTH CAROLINA +1.5 (-110) if you feel more comfortable with the small spread, but the better value is on the moneyline.Over/UnderUNDER 140.5 (-110) is a solid play in the ACC nightcap Thursday.We saw the Under cash in the first meeting in the penultimate game for each of these ACC combatants.
